backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT platform on the Internet Computer, managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minting with role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features in Gallery.tsx: halving the hero banner height and replacing the rotating quotes with a single static Walter Russell quote.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and config files for the NFT light-art portfolio application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light-art NFT portfolio app, set to German language with a React root div and Vite module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-themed Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using create/update mutation hooks with validation, error display, and German-language toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Admin component that lists all NFT collections with edit and delete actions, showing skeletons while loading and a confirmation dialog before deletion.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating and editing NFT items, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, and price input in ICP.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Admin list component displaying all NFTs with thumbnails, collection names, prices, and delete/edit actions with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Card component that displays a legacy artwork's image, title, and description with hover scale and overlay effects.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for displaying a minted on-chain NFT with token ID, owner principal, mint date, and optional own-NFT highlight.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper providing a sticky header with logo, navigation, login button, page content slot, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: Modal dialog for minting a new NFT by uploading an image and entering title/description, with drag-and-drop support and progress feedback.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar with route-aware buttons for Home, NFT Gallery, Blog, Contact, and conditionally Upload and Admin links based on identity and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: Small badge component that renders a styled 'NFT' label with a sparkles icon.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: Card component displaying an NFT item's image, title, collection, ICP price, on-chain badge, and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A card component displaying an NFT collection with image, title, description, and an external link to the Getgems marketplace. Handles image loading/error states with skeleton fallback.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a grid of NFT collection cards using static data for seven Istvan Seidel collections hosted on Getgems/TON blockchain.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A modal dialog showing detailed NFT information (image, title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price) with copy-to-clipboard fields and an ICP explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT technology, automatic minting, and ICP architecture for site visitors unfamiliar with blockchain concepts.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: A compact component displaying NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) with an external link to the ICP dashboard explorer.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: A reusable component that displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: An empty file with no content.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a `StaticBlogPost` interface and exports an array of static German-language blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light, red light).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend `addCollection` method and invalidates the `nft-collections` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls `addNFT` on the backend actor, fetches the newly created NFT, and invalidates `nft-items` queries, with auth error parsing.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates both `nft-collections` and `nft-items` queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the `nft-items` query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend with a no-op query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Stub query hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old blog backend so static blog posts are used instead.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, with loading state derived from both actor and query status.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via `listAllNFTs` from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFT items via `getAllNFTs` from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old single-artwork backend lookup.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-based artwork backend lookup.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Stub query hook that always returns null for a single blog post, deferring to static posts instead.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, enabled only when the user is authenticated and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's own issued NFTs via `listMyNFTs`, scoped by principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: Query hook that checks whether the authenticated caller has admin privileges via the backend `isCallerAdmin` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Custom React hook that checks if the current Internet Identity caller is an admin, with a configurable timeout, loading/error states, and a retry mechanism.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that calls the backend `mintNFT` actor method and invalidates NFT-related query caches on success, with auth error parsing.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile via the backend actor and invalidates the `currentUserProfile` query on success.
Stub mutation hook for a contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection via the backend actor and invalidates the `nft-collections` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the `nft-items` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork uploads that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Custom hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and uploading via the backend actor, returning the resulting `ExternalBlob`.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm light/dark art-themed color palette, plus Google Fonts imports.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that guards access by checking authentication and admin status (with timeout handling), then renders tabs for managing NFT collections and items.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards, and shows a 'New Post' button for authenticated admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image upload, redirecting non-admins to the blog listing.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Displays a single blog post by ID, merging static local posts with backend-fetched data and showing title, date, optional image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook and shows success/error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page showing a hero banner, a static quote, and NFT collections with loading skeletons and error/retry handling.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT showing its image, title, description, collection badge, price, mint date, and a link to the ICP dashboard explorer.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Full NFT gallery page with tabs for all NFTs and issued NFTs, collection filtering, mint modal, detail modal, and wallet/login state handling.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React page component for uploading and minting NFTs, handling image selection, collection assignment, price input, upload progress, and post-mint navigation with Internet Identity authentication guard.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions to merge static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, find a post by ID from either source, and format timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a textarea-based fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten a principal string with ellipsis and optionally return the full or shortened form for display.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing sensitive params from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended typography/font families, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations including accordion and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking version, architectural notes, existing features, and pending requests to halve the Gallery page hero banner height and display only the single UZ quote.
